items.q: I worked, I get a couple of those little digs with an older brother of Erroll Garner. ... No, another one that never became popular. He stayed around Pittsburgh.

ctx.x: No, only after I got to New York. But I knew Mary Lou was from Pittsburgh. I worked, I get a couple of those little digs with an older brother of Erroll Garner.

No, another one that never became popular. He stayed around Pittsburgh. And then there was a very popular drummer around Pittsburgh by the name of 'Honey Boy'. And a piano player I know, Nini Waters. Of course now, I remember by this time I was becoming familiar with some of the local musicians and I think Billy Eckstine was working with one of the local big bands in Pittsburgh before he got his own band, and before he went with Earl Hines.
